# 1 Clement Chapter 43 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 43 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_043_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 43

**43:1** And what wonder is it, if those who were in Christ entrusted with such a work sent forward men of this character, when even the blessed Moses, "a faithful servant in all his house," recorded in the holy writings all that was enjoined upon him?

**43:2** And after him the remaining prophets followed, also bearing testimony to the laws he had given.

**43:3** For when rivalry arose over the priesthood, and the tribes were disputing among themselves which of them should be adorned with the glorious title, he commanded the twelve tribal leaders to bring him rods inscribed with the name of each tribe; and taking them, he bound and sealed them with the signet rings of the tribal leaders, and laid them on the table of God in the tabernacle of testimony.

**43:4** And after shutting the tabernacle, he sealed the keys as well, in the same way as the rods.

**43:5** And he said: "Brothers, whichever tribe's rod blossoms — that tribe God has chosen to serve him as priests and to minister to him."

**43:6** And when morning came, he gathered all Israel together — the six hundred thousand men — and showed the seals to the tribal leaders and opened the tabernacle of testimony and drew out the rods; and the rod of Aaron was found not only to have budded, but also to be bearing fruit.

**43:7** What do you think, beloved? Did Moses not know beforehand that this would happen? Certainly he knew. But in order that there might be no disorder in Israel, he acted in this manner, that the name of the true and only God might be glorified; to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*LOGOS preserves the narrative detail of the Aaron's rod episode precisely, using "tabernacle of testimony" (the LXX technical term for the Tent of Meeting) and "signet rings" for the sealing.*
